recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-panel band portrait featuring five musicians separated by thin vertical white lines, set against a gradient background of red and light blue. The composition uses a mix of expressive hand-drawn script and formal serif typography at the top, creating a contrast between raw energy and traditional elegance.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical slats dividing a single group portrait into five distinct columns
Contrast between the warm red upper background and cool blue lower background
Juxtaposition of expressive, gestural script with rigid, classical serif type
Uniformity of band members' dark, textured attire against the vibrant color field
coreInvariants: Five vertical panels of equal width
Thin white borders separating the panels

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Band members occupy the full height of the central graphic area, arranged horizontally across the five panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, gestural script logo in the top left corner serves as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the expressive script at the top left, across the serif subtitle, then down through the vertical slats to the band members' boots.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial white space at the top and bottom of the frame provides breathing room for the typography and stabilizes the busy central image.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Red and Sky Blue (gradient background within panels)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background gradient contrasts with the low-value, dark textures of the subjects' clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of gestural brush script and transitional serif
letterConstructionRules: Script: High-speed brush strokes with varying pressure and rough edges
Serif: High contrast between thick and thin strokes with sharp, bracketed serifs
Lowercase serif for the secondary text to maintain a modest profile
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated descenders and ascenders in the script to create a sense of motion
Tight kerning in the serif text for a compact, modern feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive script paired with a formal, lowercase serif for a 'rebel vs. tradition' aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the energetic, hand-drawn feel of the primary logo.
Provides the high-contrast serif look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a white square canvas. In the center, place five vertical rectangular panels separated by thin white gaps. Inside these panels, apply a vertical gradient from vibrant red at the top to sky blue at the bottom. Place full-body portraits of five rock musicians in 80s glam attire (leather, scarves, hats) across the panels so they appear as one continuous image split by the slats.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, black, expressive brush-style script logo in the top left. To its right, add a subtitle in a medium-sized, black, high-contrast serif font in all lowercase letters.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly five vertical panels?
Is the script text significantly larger than the serif text?
Are the divider lines thin and white?

mustRedesign: Original band name and album title text

mustAchieve: Smooth color transition in the gradient

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical lines are perfectly parallel.
Check that the gradient transition is consistent across all five panels.
Verify the script text has a 'hand-painted' texture.
Confirm the white space at the top and bottom is balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Divide a central image into five vertical slats with thin white borders, set against a red-to-blue gradient, and top with a combination of aggressive brush script and elegant serif typography.
